meta.title: AI-Driven Physical Discovery and Materials Design · CMSG
meta.description: AI-driven physical discovery, materials inverse design, and nanoconfined transport research.

title: Questions first. Methods in service of understanding.
intro: We use machine learning not only to predict material properties, but also to formulate physical descriptors, explore materials space, and design new candidates in reverse.

items.title: Materials inverse design
items.meta: FULL (A, C, S) SPACE · PROPERTY-DRIVEN SEARCH
items.summary: Starting from target properties, we search for suitable candidates across the vast space defined by elements, stoichiometry, and structure.

items.title: Physical discovery
items.summary: We investigate the physical mechanisms behind macroscopic material properties, using superhard and negative-thermal-expansion materials to uncover interpretable and transferable structure-property relationships.

items.title: Water and nanoconfined transport
items.summary: We study how confinement reshapes molecular interactions, dynamics, and transport at the molecular scale, seeking mechanisms to control nanofluidic friction, water diffusion, and water activation.
